claim: Anthropic offers two distinct paths to building production agents: Managed Agents (hosted autonomous agent runtime, launched April 2026, Anthropic handles infra/scaling/safety) and the Agent SDK (released April 2025, developer toolkit for self-hosted agents with full control over orchestration and data residency).
stance_target: infrastructure/deployment architecture choices for a software factory (Pillar 5)
scope_conditions: Anthropic product lineup as of 2026, per consulting partner
quoted_support: Managed agents are Anthropic's hosted autonomous agent runtime, launched in April 2026... The second path is the Agent SDK, released in April 2025. The SDK gives you the building blocks -- agent loops, tool definitions, context management, multi-agent handoffs, and guardrails -- to build and host agents on your own infrastructure.

claim: Production-grade agent deployments require structured logging of every action/decision, human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-stakes operations, hard per-run cost budget limits, output validation, escalation rules, and real-time oversight dashboards.
stance_target: quality control and cost-control architecture for autonomous agents (Pillar 1/6)
quoted_support: Every agent we deploy includes structured logging of every action and decision, human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-stakes operations, cost tracking with hard budget limits per run, output validation against quality criteria, escalation rules for edge cases, and real-time dashboards for team oversight.

claim: Typical deployment timelines reported by an Anthropic consulting partner: a single managed-agent workflow in 1-2 weeks; a multi-agent system with SDK orchestration, MCP integrations, and full monitoring in 3-5 weeks.
stance_target: implementation phasing estimates for software factory build-out (phasing section)
scope_conditions: single consulting vendor's self-reported client timelines, unverified, vendor marketing content
quoted_support: A single managed agent workflow: 1 to 2 weeks from kickoff to production. A multi-agent system with SDK orchestration, MCP integrations, and full monitoring: 3 to 5 weeks.
